universes.U1_CANDIDATE_B_DATES: all independently reproduced Candidate B trade dates
universes.U2_PF1_FAVORITE_REGIME_DATES: U1 dates where Candidate B selected the unique max market_q_raw bucket

selector: minimum(model_p - market_q_raw) after excluding the unique market favorite
fixed_blocks: five consecutive blocks of 34 dates from the ordered canonical 170-date universe

verdict_policy.promising: Both U1 and U2 P1 have positive PnL and ROI, remove-top-5 PnL > 0, at least 3 positive fixed blocks, U1 trades >= 30 and U2 trades >= 15
verdict_policy.thin: At least one of U1 or U2 P1 has positive PnL, but the promising robustness gate is not fully met
verdict_policy.not_established: Neither U1 nor U2 P1 has positive PnL
